art_direction: 37岁原创女主穿长袖工装和围裙，在陶艺室抱着釉色花瓶。
composition_variation: Feature an original 37-year-old anime woman with short wavy salt-and-pepper hair, standing in a peaceful pottery studio and holding a finished ceramic vase. She wears an opaque teal long-sleeved work shirt, full trousers, and a cream apron. Use tactile pastel drawing, dusty rose shelves, warm clay textures, and diffuse window light. Her mature face and strong relaxed posture feel self-possessed and welcoming, with clean natural hands. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
